stage1.impression: A clean but clearly CG home-cinema room: the walls, ceiling, floor and velvet chairs are flat, uniform surfaces with no texture at 1:1, the Douglas fir niche is a pink-salmon laminate brighter than anything else, and the large lilac screen and the cold blue-white Orbs pull the eye away from the speakers. The speakers read as clear grey boxes with a bright white interior, not as tinted cast acrylic, so the frame has no hero and no single colour. As it stands a design magazine would see a generic showroom or home theatre, not a specific listening bar.

blocking_9: Shell surfaces must read as real board-formed concrete and old fir at 1:1 (tie holes, pour lines, board grain, checks); right wall [1090,100,1200,600] currently has lum_range 20 and no texture
Fir niche must not be the brightest surface: niche [470,175,1035,560] median 117 with 0.83% clip versus speaker body [780,360,915,530] median 93.5
Speakers must be the hero, lit by their own spots and reading as thick smoked cast acrylic with glowing polished edges
Light must be one warm 2400-2700 K set: Orbs [60,555,135,600] and speaker interior read blue (b_median 168 > r 156; 107 > 93)
Screen [0,170,260,420] at median 127 and lilac must drop to a quiet secondary element
Foreground oak table [0,590,185,800] must read as oak, not a flat salmon block at median 147
Visible signs of life (glass, coat, record) in the frame, and furniture with real upholstery detail (seams, nap, creases)
A composition that reads as a specific bar at night rather than a home cinema: no cut-off objects in the corners

defects.what: Fir niche over-lit and pink-salmon, reads as laminate; hot scallops high on the boards above the speakers instead of on them
Projection screen too bright (median 127) and lilac-magenta; competes with the speakers
Orb lamp globe reads cold blue-white, plastic-looking; off the warm rig
Speaker reads as clear glass box with a bluish white interior; no smoked tint visible; no edge glow
Foreground oak table is a flat salmon-pink block with no grain, plastic
Orb cut by the bottom-left corner
Walls flat, untextured, no concrete character (lum_range 20)
Ceiling/beams barely legible, no beam detail, mostly near-black mush
Floor is a uniform dark plane with no polish, reflection or texture
Velvet tub chairs read as smooth CG blocks: no nap, seams or creases; repeated identical copies
Sleeve leaning on the plinth reads as a blank beige card
Horn top reflects a hard clipped highlight that reads as a mirror box

changes.problem: The fir niche, not the speakers, is the brightest thing in the frame, and its pools land above the speakers.

evidence.measured: niche median 117.2, p95 239.5, clip 0.83%; vertical profile peaks 171.8 at the top third of the boards; speaker body median 93.5

change.setting: altar spots and lit niche strip
change.from: altar 2 x spot 28.0 W, cone 18.0 deg; lit niche strip 0.5
change.to: altar spots re-aimed at the speaker cabinets' centres (about 0.9 m above the plinth), cone 14 deg, 35 W; lit niche strip 0.15

changes.expected: Fir drops to a warm mid-tone grazing behind the speakers; light pools on the cabinets and plinths; no clipping on the boards.

changes.problem: The screen is the second-brightest, largest light patch and reads lilac.
changes.expected: Screen recedes to a dim grey image below the speakers' brightness.

changes.problem: Orbs and the speaker interior are cooler than the rest of the rig and read blue-white plastic.

evidence.measured: Orb r 156 g 162 b 168 at median 161; speaker interior r 93 b 107

change.setting: Orb liner glow colour and render white_balance_k
change.to: Orb liner glow 0.0015 in 2400 K (#FFB46B); white_balance_k 2900

changes.expected: Orbs glow as warm dim pools; whites in the speakers turn warm ivory under the spots.

changes.problem: The foreground oak table reads as a flat salmon plastic block.

evidence.measured: lum_median 147.4, r 156 g 145 b 137, no grain visible at 2x

change.to: smoked/fumed oak stain with visible open grain and a satin sheen; downlights 170 W

changes.expected: Table reads as dark oak with a soft specular edge, around mid-tone.

changes.problem: Walls, ceiling and floor are flat CG planes with no concrete or timber character.

evidence.measured: lum_range 20.1, p5 20.4 / p95 40.5; floor [250,520,700,800] uniform, median 33

change.setting: concrete tone and sheen, floor polish
change.to: board-formed concrete with 100 mm board grain, tie holes and pour lines in bump and roughness (roughness varied 0.55-0.8); polished concrete floor, roughness 0.3, to pick up the plinth and Orb reflections

changes.expected: Wall grain and floor reflections give texture in the shadows without raising their median much.

changes.problem: No atmosphere: beams and pools are invisible, the darks are empty rather than deep.

evidence.measured: ceiling median 14.6, p5 6.2; no visible spot beams

changes.expected: Faint shafts from the altar spots and a soft lift in the upper dark.

changes.problem: No sign of life in this frame; the props listed on the card are outside it, and the sleeve by the plinth is a blank card.

evidence.measured: seen: empty tables, no coat, glass or record visible; beige blank rectangle at [775,515,840,580]

change.from: coat, record and sleeve off-frame; blank sleeve against plinth
change.to: a half-full rocks glass and a record out of its sleeve on the foreground table; the coat over the nearest tub chair arm; sleeve with printed (monochrome) art against the plinth

changes.expected: The room reads as in use tonight.

changes.problem: 24 mm wide view crops objects at the corners and makes the room read as a home cinema rather than a close, seated listening room.

evidence.measured: Orb cut by the frame corner; chair cut at left edge; empty floor dominates the lower middle

change.to: position [13.2, 1.6, 1.15] (seated eye level), lens 35 mm, aimed at [16.6, 3.2, 1.0], foreground table and Orb fully in the lower-left third

changes.expected: Tighter, warmer frame with the pair larger and the empty floor reduced.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speakers' Smoke tint read as thick tinted cast acrylic with glowing polished edges rather than a clear grey box with a white interior
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour, material and parts are fixed; only their lighting may change.

out_of_scope.request: Velvet tub chairs with modelled seams, nap and varied creases instead of smooth identical blocks
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed in the room's design; this needs a better asset of the same chair, which is an asset decision for the owner.

out_of_scope.request: Rethink why the concept cannot reach 8.5: the shell, floor and furniture are low-detail CG surfaces and the altar reads as a home cinema
out_of_scope.why: Light and grade changes reach about 6. A magazine-grade 8.5 needs scanned or high-detail concrete, fir and upholstery materials and furniture assets, which is beyond tuning settings.
